info.title: Travel Planner implemented API
info.description: Implemented liveness, no-fetch editorial resolution, and verified-owner approximate candidate generation/atomic apply. No save/editor/share journey is claimed. Public discovery search adds category/zone filtering, bounded paging and optional transient Brave results with no-key catalog fallback.

post.summary: Bounded two-city discovery with explicit catalog/provider provenance
post.description: Public catalog search; provider opt-in is default false and requires server configuration. Applications page over at most 100 transient provider results plus 30 local records; this is not native Brave offset pagination or a stable provider snapshot. radius_m is a relevance bias; max_distance_km is an explicit filter. Draft and request-only results are not verified editorial data or durable trip stops. Exact repeated records have explicit removal accounting. Conflicting or suspected duplicates keep separate facts/source rights and require confirmation; review relationships are bounded with an explicit truncation flag.

post.summary: Submit original permission-attested user text and confirmed pin for private review
post.description: 8192 bytes maximum. No scraped Google/Brave facts or raw Maps URLs. Server verifies Auth; database derives ownership, serializes 5 new submissions per24h/20 active per owner, stores exact idempotency fingerprint and suspected public duplicate hints. Exact retry/identical-payload duplicate returns existing identity. Never writes editorial tables or auto-publishes.

post.summary: Versioned owner withdrawal/restore or moderator verification/approval/rejection/restore
post.description: 4096 bytes maximum. Owner may withdraw any own active state; restore rejected/withdrawn goes to submitted and obeys active cap. Moderator verify submitted -> verification; approve verification -> approved; reject submitted/verification/approved; restore rejected -> verification. Approve/reject requires a review note of at least10 characters. Every successful state change increments version and atomically appends a private audit. Approved is community-reviewed, never verified hours/prices/entrance.

post.summary: Stateless source-validated hybrid candidate preview, never an owner trip mutation
post.description: Public, bounded65536-byte strict draft/preferences. Server resolves known editorial facts and rejects forged manual verification/provider metadata. Optional Brave/Groq opt-in defaults false and still requires configured account/cost/data controls. Bounded provider failures use explicit deterministic/catalog/approximate fallbacks. Exact original stop identity/order/required/locks is preserved; suggestions retain complete source metadata. Request-only external facts/identities are excluded from AI and exportable candidates; only an aggregate independent-confirmation count is returned. Existing deterministic planner plus post-verification checks every accounted stop/day/lock/required diagnostic. Result requires explicit confirmation and is not saved, shared or applied through this endpoint. Anonymous public access cannot load or mutate owner trips. UI-B may also return a transient sibling outside exportable data, for view-only request content. It is no-store, never passed to AI/save/export, clears on input/page hide/visibility loss/5min, with provider IDs removed and source URLs stripped of credentials/query/fragment. Independent entry opens a fresh manual pin flow without copying provider facts.
